button.name: Button
button.description: Polymorphic button or link primitive with OKLCH perceptual variants, sizes, Live 2.5 hooks, and native Popover targeting.

href.description: Renders an anchor tag when provided

kgn-get.description: Kongono Live HTTP GET action URL

kgn-post.description: Kongono Live HTTP POST action URL

kgn-swap.description: Kongono Live swap strategy (morph, innerHTML, etc.)

data-z-open.description: Standalone runtime selector to open an overlay

data-z-close.description: Standalone runtime selector to close an overlay

data-z-toggle.description: Standalone runtime selector to toggle an overlay

data-z-set-theme.description: OKLCH theme slug to activate and persist (e.g. washi, sumi, matcha)

data-z-cycle-theme.description: Comma-separated OKLCH theme slugs to cycle through on click (e.g. washi,sumi,matcha)

data-z-set-density.description: Two-Gear UI density preset to activate and persist

data-z-cycle-density.description: Comma-separated density presets to cycle through on click (e.g. calm,default,compact)

data-z-toast.description: Title of a stacked programmatic toast to fire on click

data-z-toast-desc.description: Optional description for declarative toast or undo notification

data-z-undo.description: Grace-window undoable action label; holds commit until countdown finishes or Undo is clicked

data-z-undo-delay.description: Undo grace window duration in milliseconds (1000-30000)

badge.name: Badge
badge.description: Compact status pill with optional live status indicator dot derived via OKLCH color-mix.

card.name: Card
card.description: Container-query aware surface card with kicker, title, subtitle, optional badge, and footer.
card.example: <x-ui.card kicker="Architecture" title="Zero-Node CSS" badge="OKLCH">Built in pure PHP 8.5.</x-ui.card>

alert.name: Alert
alert.description: Accessible ARIA status/alert callout banner with semantic OKLCH surfaces.
alert.example: <x-ui.alert variant="success" title="Verified">0 inline scripts and 0 npm packages.</x-ui.alert>

kbd.name: Keyboard Shortcut
kbd.description: Tactile monospace keycap indicator for command palettes and documentation.

avatar.name: Avatar
avatar.description: Initials monogram avatar with accessible name and optional live presence dot.

input.name: Text Input
input.description: Accessible form input using CSS :has() to auto-tint labels on focus and aria-invalid errors.
input.example: <x-ui.input name="email" type="email" label="Work Email" placeholder="founder@acme.dev" hint="Never shared." />

select.name: Select
select.description: Native accessible select dropdown with label binding, validation state, and Live 2.5 k-model.
select.example: <x-ui.select name="region" label="Region"><option value="us-east">US East</option><option value="eu-west">EU West</option></x-ui.select>

textarea.name: Textarea
textarea.description: Multi-line text input with vertical resize, accessible label, error state, and Live 2.5 k-model.
textarea.example: <x-ui.textarea name="notes" label="Release Notes" placeholder="Summarize changes..." rows="3" />

switch.name: Toggle Switch
switch.description: Zero-JavaScript accessible ARIA switch powered purely by CSS :has(input:checked).

progress.name: Progress Meter
progress.description: Zero-inline-style semantic HTML <progress> meter compatible with strict style-src 'self' CSP.
progress.example: <x-ui.progress label="CSS Tree-Shake Savings" value="78" max="100" variant="emerald" />

skeleton.name: Skeleton Loader
skeleton.description: Reduced-motion aware shimmer placeholders including composite card, KPI, and table presets plus automatic Live 2.5 loading visibility.

lines.description: Number of stacked placeholders for line/title/block/circle (1-8)

live-only.description: Shows automatically only while a parent Live 2.5 request or aria-busy=true is active

empty-state.name: Empty State
empty-state.description: Framed empty-collection callout with kanji/symbol emblem, message, and CTA action slot.
empty-state.example: <x-ui.empty-state icon="形" title="No deployments yet" description="Ship your first release with zero npm."><x-ui.button variant="primary" size="sm">Create Deploy</x-ui.button></x-ui.empty-state>

kpi.name: KPI Metric Card
kpi.description: Container-query responsive executive metric tile with trend badge and hint text.
kpi.example: <x-ui.kpi label="CSS Gzipped" value="3.4 KB" delta="-82%" trend="up" variant="emerald" hint="Tree-shaken in PHP" />

table.name: Data Table
table.description: Density-aware responsive data table with instant search filtering, clickable aria-sort headers, row selection + bulk action bar, Popover column toggles, and strict-CSP CSV export.

searchable.description: Displays live client-side search filter toolbar and row count

sortable.description: Makes column headers clickable and keyboard-sortable with aria-sort

selectable.description: Adds Select-All/row checkboxes (with Shift+Click range select) and bulk action bar

column-toggle.description: Adds native Top-Layer Popover Columns visibility picker

exportable.description: Adds strict-CSP RFC 4180 CSV export of selected or visible rows

table.example: EngineGzip KBZokeibi9.9 KB

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.description: Accessible ARIA tablist driven by Kongono Live 2.5 zero-eval signals.
tabs.example:
Live view
Markup

accordion.name: Accordion
accordion.description: Native HTML <details>/<summary> disclosure supporting exclusive groups via the native name attribute.
accordion.example: <x-ui.accordion title="Why zero npm?" name="faq" open="true">Pure PHP 8.5 compiles and tree-shakes CSS directly.</x-ui.accordion>

popover.name: Top-Layer Popover
popover.description: Browser-native HTML Top-Layer Popover API with @starting-style transitions and light-dismiss — zero z-index bugs and 0 bytes JS.
popover.example: <x-ui.popover id="pop-actions" trigger="Quick Actions" title="Top-Layer Popover">Click outside or press Esc to light-dismiss.</x-ui.popover>

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.description: Pure CSS hover and keyboard focus-within tooltip with ARIA role=tooltip.
tooltip.example: <x-ui.tooltip text="Zero-JS CSS tooltip" position="top"><x-ui.button size="sm" variant="outline">Hover or Focus</x-ui.button></x-ui.tooltip>

modal.name: Modal Dialog
modal.description: Accessible ARIA dialog overlay controlled by Kongono Live 2.5 reactive signals with strict CSP safety.
modal.example: <x-ui.modal id="confirm-modal" title="Confirm Action" show="modalOpen" variant="danger">Type DELETE to proceed.</x-ui.modal>

drawer.name: Slide-Over Drawer
drawer.description: Right-edge detail inspector drawer wired to Kongono Live 2.5 reactive signals.
drawer.example: <x-ui.drawer id="inspector-drawer" title="Deployment Inspector" show="drawerOpen">Inspect headers and CSP policy.</x-ui.drawer>

toast.name: Toast & Undo Queue
toast.description: Polite ARIA live-region notification supporting inline, floating, stacked programmatic queue (Zokeibi.toast), and declarative grace-window Undo actions.

floating.description: Fixes toast to bottom-right viewport corner

action-label.description: Optional inline action button label (e.g. Undo)

toast.example: <x-ui.toast title="Lease Archived" description="Click Undo within 5 seconds to restore." variant="amber" action-label="Undo" dismissible="true" />

command-palette.name: Command Palette (Cmd+K)
command-palette.description: Strict-CSP Cmd+K / Ctrl+K command launcher with keyboard arrow navigation, live search filter, and ARIA dialog/listbox semantics.
command-palette.example: <x-ui.command-palette id="app-cmdk" trigger-label="Quick Jump" items="studio:Open Token Studio:/studio:S|home:Component Gallery:/:G" />

combobox.name: Searchable Combobox
combobox.description: Accessible ARIA 1.2 searchable select combobox with live filtering and hidden form value binding.

options.description: Pipe-separated value:Label pairs or associative array

combobox.example: <x-ui.combobox name="region" label="Deploy Region" options="us-east:US East|eu-central:EU Central|ap-northeast:Tokyo" value="ap-northeast" />

dropzone.name: File Dropzone
dropzone.description: Drag-and-drop accessible file upload target with selected file chips, ready for Kongono UploadedFileStore.

hint.description: Allowed file types and max size guidance

datepicker.name: Date Picker
datepicker.description: OKLCH-styled native date input paired with strict-CSP quick preset chips (Today, +7 Days, +30 Days).

stepper.name: Step Indicator
stepper.description: Zero-JS multi-step onboarding and checkout wizard indicator with aria-current=step semantics.

pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.description: Accessible pagination bar pairing natively with Kongono QueryBuilder::paginate() and optional Live 2.5 morphing.

live-target.description: Optional Live 2.5 kgn-target selector for morphing

date-range.name: Date-Range Calendar
date-range.description: Interactive 2-click calendar range picker with month navigation, OKLCH range bands, quick SaaS presets, and dual ISO form inputs.

presets.description: Show quick range presets (Last 7d, 30d, Month, Quarter)

date-range.example: <x-ui.date-range name="window" label="Reporting Window" start="2026-11-01" end="2026-11-18" presets="true" />

multi-select.name: Multi-Select Tag Combobox
multi-select.description: Searchable ARIA 1.2 multi-select tag picker with removable pill chips, Backspace deletion, and array form inputs (name[]).

options.description: Pipe-separated value:Label pairs or associative array

selected.description: Comma-separated initially selected values or array

chart.name: Pure SVG Chart & Sparkline
chart.description: Zero-JavaScript server-rendered accessible SVG Sparkline, Bar, and Donut charts themed automatically via OKLCH tokens.

data.description: Pipe-separated Label:Value pairs or associative numeric array

editor.name: Markdown / Rich-Text Editor
editor.description: Strict-CSP Markdown editor with formatting toolbar, Write/Split/Preview tabs, word counter, and XSS-safe DOM live preview.
editor.example: <x-ui.editor name="body" label="Release Notes" value="### Zokeibi v1.2\nShip **zero-npm** UI with `zokeibi prove`." />

otp-input.name: OTP / 2FA Code Input
otp-input.description: Multi-box numeric 2FA / TOTP verification input with auto-advance, Backspace jump-back, and one-paste auto-fill.

hint.description: Helper text below the code boxes

otp-input.example: <x-ui.otp-input name="totp_code" label="Authenticator Code" length="6" hint="Paste or enter the 6-digit code." />

copy-field.name: Copy-to-Clipboard Field
copy-field.description: One-click copyable API key, webhook secret, or CLI snippet field with optional masked Show/Hide reveal toggle.

masked.description: Masks sensitive secrets until Show is clicked

timeline.name: Activity Timeline
timeline.description: Zero-JS vertical chronological timeline for audit logs, deploys, order events, and incident trails.

items.description: Double-semicolon separated Title|Time|Meta|Variant rows or array

timeline.example: <x-ui.timeline items="Deployed v1.2|2m ago|FrankenPHP cluster healthy|emerald;;API Key Rotated|1h ago|Performed by admin@acme.dev|blue" />

breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumb Trail
breadcrumb.description: Zero-JS accessible hierarchical navigation trail with aria-current=page on the active segment.

checkbox.name: Checkbox
checkbox.description: Zero-JS accessible styled checkbox with OKLCH accent check animation and optional helper description.
checkbox.example: <x-ui.checkbox name="terms" label="I accept the Terms of Service" description="Required to activate your workspace." checked="true" />

radio-group.name: Radio & Card Group
radio-group.description: Zero-JS accessible fieldset radio group supporting compact lists or selectable :has(:checked) SaaS plan cards.

layout.description: Standard stacked list or interactive selectable cards

radio-group.example: <x-ui.radio-group name="plan" label="Billing Tier" layout="cards" value="pro" options="starter:Starter:Free forever|pro:Pro:$29/mo · Unlimited proofs|enterprise:Enterprise:Custom SLA" />

dropdown.name: Dropdown Action Menu
dropdown.description: Zero-JS structured action menu built on native HTML Top-Layer Popover API with dividers, danger items, and keyboard shortcut badges.

items.description: Pipe-separated Label:href:shortcut items (use --- for divider, prefix danger: for destructive item)

segmented.name: Segmented Control
segmented.description: Zero-JS tactile segmented switch (e.g. Monthly / Annual or List / Grid) powered by native radios and CSS :has(:checked).

spinner.name: Loading Spinner
spinner.description: Zero-JS prefers-reduced-motion-safe inline loading spinner with ARIA status semantics for Live 2.5 indicators.

slider.name: Range Slider
slider.description: Accessible OKLCH range slider with live <output> unit readout for quotas, filters, and model settings.
slider.example: <x-ui.slider name="seats" label="Team Seat Limit" min="5" max="100" step="5" value="25" unit=" seats" />

divider.name: Divider / Separator
divider.description: Zero-JS horizontal or vertical hairline separator with optional centered text caption.

label.description: Optional centered label for horizontal dividers

description-list.name: Description List
description-list.description: Zero-JS responsive semantic <dl>/<dt>/<dd> metadata grid for invoices, profiles, and deployment summaries.

items.description: Pipe-separated Key:Value pairs or associative array

code-block.name: Code Block
code-block.description: Multi-line code display framed with filename header, language badge, and strict-CSP 1-click Copy button.

code.description: Code text (or provide inside component slot)

code-block.example:
<x-ui.code-block filename="routes.php" language="php">#[Get('/health')]
public function health(): Response { return Response::json(['ok' => true]); }</x-ui.code-block>

tag-input.name: Free-Form Tag Input
tag-input.description: Type any arbitrary tag and press Enter or Comma to create removable chips synced to hidden name[] inputs, with Backspace deletion.

placeholder.default: Type a tag and press Enter...

banner.name: Announcement Banner
banner.description: Full-width top announcement, maintenance, or trial-status bar with optional CTA button and strict-CSP dismiss button.

dismissible.description: Shows dismiss button wired to data-z-close

banner.example: <x-ui.banner variant="emerald" title="Zokeibi v1.0 Ready" action-label="Open Studio" action-href="/studio" dismissible="true">All 55 primitives pass strict CSP.</x-ui.banner>

rating.name: Star Rating
rating.description: Zero-JavaScript interactive 5-star review and feedback picker powered purely by CSS :has(:checked) and sibling hover.

sidebar.name: Sidebar Navigation
sidebar.description: Zero-JS grouped vertical SaaS navigation rail with section headings, aria-current=page highlight, and badge counts.

active.description: Href or label of the active page

input-group.name: Input Group (Addons)
input-group.description: Zero-JS unified input field with attached monospace prefix and/or suffix addons (domains, currency, ports).

prefix.description: Leading attached addon text (e.g. https:// or $)

suffix.description: Trailing attached addon text (e.g. .kongono.dev or USD)

input-group.example: <x-ui.input-group name="subdomain" label="Workspace URL" prefix="https://" suffix=".kongono.dev" value="acme" />

number-input.name: Number Stepper
number-input.description: Tactile minus/plus numeric quantity stepper respecting min, max, and step bounds for carts and seat quotas.
number-input.example: <x-ui.number-input name="workers" label="FrankenPHP Workers" min="1" max="64" step="1" value="4" />

avatar-group.name: Avatar Group
avatar-group.description: Zero-JS overlapping stacked team avatars with hover lift and automatic +N overflow counter badge.

items.description: Pipe-separated Initials:FullName pairs or associative array

max.description: Max visible avatars before +N overflow pill

carousel.name: Scroll-Snap Carousel
carousel.description: Zero-JavaScript horizontal snap-scrolling card/testimonial carousel built on native CSS scroll-snap-type.

items.description: Double-semicolon separated Title|Body slide entries (or pass custom slides in slot)

carousel.example: <x-ui.carousel label="Platform Highlights" items="Zero npm|Pure PHP 8.5 CSS compiler;;Strict CSP|0 inline scripts or styles;;WCAG AA|Verified across every theme" />

tree.name: Tree View
tree.description: Zero-JavaScript nested expandable file, folder, and permission hierarchy powered by recursive native HTML <details>.

password-input.name: Password Input & Strength
password-input.description: Strict-CSP password input with Show/Hide reveal button and live 4-segment OKLCH strength indicator (zero inline style).

signature-pad.name: ESIGN Signature Pad
signature-pad.description: Strict-CSP ESIGN/UETA signature capture supporting pointer/touch canvas drawing and typed-name fallback with hidden PNG/text + signature_type fields.

name.description: Hidden form field name (also emits <name>_type as drawn|typed)

signer-name.description: Optional prefilled legal name for typed mode

money-input.name: Currency / Money Input
money-input.description: Locale-formatted financial input with tabular numerals that submits exact integer cents (minor units) via string-safe math with zero floating-point rounding.

value.description: Initial integer amount in minor units (e.g. 185000 for 1,850.00)

min-cents.description: Optional minimum value in minor units

max-cents.description: Optional maximum value in minor units

money-input.example: <x-ui.money-input name="monthly_rent_cents" label="Monthly Rent" value="185000" currency="USD" symbol="$" hint="Submits exact integer 185000." />

alert-dialog.name: Destructive Alert Dialog
alert-dialog.description: Hardened ARIA role=alertdialog confirmation overlay that refuses backdrop dismissal, safely focuses Cancel on open, and supports typed phrase gates (e.g. type DELETE).

cancel-label.description: Safe cancel button label (focused on open)

confirm-text.description: Optional verbatim phrase required before enabling confirm button

csrf.description: Optional CSRF token for form submission

alert-dialog.example: <x-ui.alert-dialog id="del-lease" title="Terminate Lease" description="This voids active auto-pay schedules." confirm-text="TERMINATE" confirm-label="Terminate Lease" />

ai-review.name: AI Extraction Review Card
ai-review.description: Human-in-the-loop split review card pairing source documents/excerpts with editable AI-extracted fields, color-coded confidence pills, and low-confidence highlights.

fields.description: Double-semicolon separated name|Label|Value|confidence rows or array

ai-review.example:
<x-ui.ai-review title="Receipt OCR Verification" model="Gemini Vision" source-label="home-depot-4012.jpg" source-excerpt="HOME DEPOT #4012
TOTAL: $184.50" fields="vendor|Vendor|Home Depot #4012|98%;;amount|Amount|$184.50|96%;;category|Category|Plumbing Repair|64%" />

approval-card.name: AI / Workflow Approval Gate
approval-card.description: Human-in-the-loop approval gate card displaying actor, risk badge, before/after diff table, optional audit rationale note, and Approve/Reject actions for Kongono #[RequiresApproval].

agent.description: Originating AI agent or workflow name

changes.description: Double-semicolon separated Field|Before|After rows or array

note-field.description: Include optional reviewer audit note input

approval-card.example: <x-ui.approval-card title="Apply Monthly Rent Increase" agent="Lease Workflow" risk="high" summary="Updates active lease ledger for Unit 4B starting Jan 1." changes="Monthly Rent|$1,800.00|$1,850.00;;Auto-Pay|Pending|Enabled" note-field="true" />

blocks.name: Responsive SaaS App Shell
blocks.description: Persistent desktop sidebar + mobile slide-over drawer, Cmd+K command palette, OKLCH theme switcher, user avatar, and Live 2.5 slot.

blocks.name: Auth Sign-In & Passkey Screen
blocks.description: Accessible sign-in card with CSRF hidden field, PRG old-input feedback, remember-me switch, and Kongono v1.22+ Passkey CTA.

blocks.name: Account & Billing Settings
blocks.description: Workspace profile form, live subscription KPIs, region combobox, and danger-zone confirmation modal.

blocks.name: 3-Tier SaaS Pricing Grid
blocks.description: Accessible 3-column Starter / Pro / Enterprise pricing layout themed automatically via OKLCH tokens.

blocks.name: Onboarding Stepper & Empty State
blocks.description: Multi-step onboarding wizard paired with a calm empty-state call to action.

blocks.name: Zero-Leak Error Page (KGN Ref)
blocks.description: Calm, accessible 404/500 error card displaying only the safe KGN-* Reference ID without leaking internals.

blocks.name: Executive Analytics Dashboard (0 B JS Charts)
blocks.description: Full analytics screen with breadcrumb trail, date-range picker, KPI strip, pure-SVG Bar/Sparkline/Donut charts, and sortable/searchable DataTable.

blocks.name: API Keys, 2FA Verification & Audit Trail
blocks.description: Developer credentials view pairing masked copy-to-clipboard PAT tokens, 6-digit OTP verification, and a zero-JS security timeline.
